title: Art Gallery Monthly Meeting
bodyHtml:

Members of the Art Gallery meet monthly to review operational procedures, discuss the status of the Art Gallery, attend to business obligations, and coordinate seasonal promotions and activities. Due to COVID-19, upcoming Art Gallery Meetings are being held via Zoom, unless otherwise noted. Instructions on how to easily join the Art Gallery meetings via Zoom (no registration required) will be sent via email one day prior to the meeting.
